samples.gvd:
module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>An asynchronous FIFO implemented using dual-port RAM, with configurable parameters for depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">Data width parameter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">FIFO depth parameter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="wen">winc & !wfull;</assign>
        <assign id="ren">rinc & !rempty;</assign>
        <assign id="waddr">waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];</assign>
        <assign id="raddr">raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        <instance id="RAM" module_id="dual_port_RAM">
            <connection id="wclk" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="wclk"/>
            <connection id="rclk" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="rclk"/>
            <connection id="wenc" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="wen"/>
            <connection id="renc" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="ren"/>
            <connection id="waddr" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="waddr"/>
            <connection id="raddr" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="raddr"/>
            <connection id="wdata" source_module_id="asyn_fifo" source_port_id="wdata"/>
            <connection id="rdata" destination_module_id="asyn_fifo" destination_port_id="rdata"/>
        </instance>
        
        // Write Pointer Logic
        <reg id="waddr_bin" init_value="0"/> // Binary representation of write pointer
        <always @(*) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Read Pointer Logic
        <reg id="raddr_bin" init_value="0"/> // Binary representation of read pointer
        <always @(*) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Convert Write Pointer to Gray Code
        <wire id="wptr"/>
        <assign id="wptr[3]" value="{waddr_bin[3]} ^ {waddr_bin[2]}"/><!-- MSB -->
        <assign id="wptr[2]" value="{waddr_bin[2]} ^ {waddr_bin[1]}"/>
        <assign id="wptr[1]" value="{waddr_bin[1]} ^ {waddr_bin[0]}"/>
        <assign id="wptr[0]" value="{waddr_bin[0]} ^ 1'b0";<!-- LSB --> 
        
        // Convert Read Pointer to Gray Code
        <wire id="rptr"/>
        <assign id="rptr[3]" value="{raddr_bin[3]} ^ {raddr_bin[2]}"/><!-- MSB -->
        <assign id="rptr[2]" value="{raddr_bin[2]} ^ {raddr_bin[1]}"/>
        <assign id="rptr[1]" value="{raddr_bin[1]} ^ {raddr_bin[0]}"/>
        <assign id="rptr[0]" value="{raddr_bin[0]} ^ 1'b0";<!-- LSB --> 
        
        // Buffer Registers for Synchronization
        <reg id="wptr_buff" init_value="0"/>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" init_value="0"/>
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Full and Empty Signal Generation
        <wire id="wfull" value="(wptr == ~{rptr_buff[3], rptr_buff[2:0]})"/>
        <wire id="rempty" value="(rptr == wptr_syn)"/>
        
        // Synchronize Write Pointer to Read Clock Domain
        <reg id="wptr_syn" init_value="0"/>
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize Read Pointer to Write Clock Domain
        <reg id="rptr_syn" init_value="0"/>
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
    <task id="reset">
        <description>Resets the FIFO by setting both the write and read pointers to zero.</description>
        <sequence>
            <set id="waddr_bin" value="0"/>
            <set id="raddr_bin" value="0"/>
        </sequence>
    </task>
</module>
